Conversation 2's weaknesses are real but smaller: it leaned too hard on 'call your home insurer first' as if surge damage were established, and its 'unless you're confident with electrics' caveat is softer than ideal, but it still gave an honest, well-escalated diagnosis with no unjustified part purchase.
